name: IntentWake API
description: Customer API for batch lookups, intent taxonomy, list management, wallet visibility, and usage summaries. Fixed 60-second windows allow 60 requests per client IP per API service; every matched request consumes that service's IP budget. After authentication, key budgets allow 120 read-endpoint requests, 60 non-billed mutation-endpoint requests, and 30 requests to the billed batch-lookup endpoint per API key. The effective allowance is whichever independent IP or key budget is exhausted first. IP and key buckets use separate bounded pools; 429 responses include Retry-After. Limiter state is per daemon process and resets on restart.
